# Postly

> Postly is an open-source, local-first Postman alternative without an account.
It is a native Rust API client and testing workspace with a CLI and desktop app.

## Canonical resources

- [Project site](https://othmaneblial.github.io/Postly/): product overview and workflow.
- [Documentation hub](https://othmaneblial.github.io/Postly/docs.html): install, migration, protocols and trust boundaries.
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/OthmaneBlial/Postly): source, README and versioned evidence.
- [Compatibility matrix](https://github.com/OthmaneBlial/Postly/blob/main/docs/compatibility.md): fixture-backed support and open gaps.
- [Progress log](https://github.com/OthmaneBlial/Postly/blob/main/docs/progress.md): local verification and release boundaries.

## Product facts

- Local project files use Git-friendly TOML collections, requests and environments.
- The shared core supports HTTP/REST, GraphQL, SSE, WebSocket and dynamic gRPC workflows.
- The CLI can run saved requests and collections without the desktop app.
- Postman Collection v2.1 and environment import/export are supported with explicit review diagnostics.
- Compatibility and benchmarks are reported as measured local evidence; full Postman parity is not claimed.
- The redesigned native UI, welcome example, desktop import/runner and JSON comparison are in the 0.2.0-preview.1 source, not the older v0.1.0 public download.
- macOS ARM64 packaging has local evidence. Clean-machine installation, notarization and Windows/Linux validation remain open.
